bugs.title: Brochure grid misaligned in two rows (Elantra 1.6 Special Edition and Santa Fe Hybrid)
bugs.technique: Layout and Alignment Testing, Visual Regression Testing, GUI Testing
bugs.description: In row 1 the long name "ELANTRA 1.6 SPECIAL EDITION" wraps and pushes its Download link down (as on the Owner's Manual page, BUG-012). In row 2 the Santa Fe Hybrid image is shorter, so its name and Download link sit higher than the other three.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click "Request a Brochure" in the blue bar under the banner
Look at the first two rows of vehicles
bugs.expected: All names and Download links in a row line up.
bugs.actual: Row 1: Elantra's Download is lower; row 2: Santa Fe Hybrid's name and Download are higher than the rest.
bugs.oracle: Visual consistency in a grid. The same component misaligns on two pages, which points to a shared template defect.

bugs.title: Owner's Manual downloads (17–76 MB) start immediately, with no file size shown and no preview
bugs.technique: Performance Testing, Volume Testing, Usability Testing, Low Bandwidth / Network Throttling Testing, Download Testing
bugs.description: Clicking Download on the Owner's Manual page downloads the PDF straight away. The files are very large and the page shows no size: Porter H-100 76.4 MB (272 pages), Elantra 1.6 SE 55.1 MB (573 pages), Tucson Hybrid 30.7 MB (754 pages), IONIQ 5 17.0 MB (703 pages). Unlike the brochure links, which open in a browser tab, there is no preview.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Go to After Sales > Owner's Manual
Click Download under ELANTRA 1.6 SPECIAL EDITION
Watch what the browser does
bugs.test_data: Porter_H-100-Owner-Manual.pdf 76,448,008 bytes; Elantra-1_6-SE-Owners-Manual.pdf 55,103,375 bytes; NX4-Hybrid-G1.6T-GDi.pdf 30,702,562 bytes; Ioniq-5-Owner-Manual.pdf 16,995,996 bytes
bugs.expected: The link shows the file type and size (e.g. "PDF, 55 MB") and opens the same way as the brochure links, or offers a preview or chapter-wise download.
bugs.actual: Files of up to 76 MB download at once with no size shown; the brochure page's links behave differently (open in a tab).
bugs.oracle: Usability and performance practice: large downloads should state their size, especially for mobile users on metered data. Consistency oracle: download links on the two pages behave differently.

bugs.title: Elantra and Porter manuals are scanned images: text cannot be searched, selected or read by screen readers
bugs.technique: Accessibility Testing, Static Testing (Reviews), Usability Testing, Download Testing
bugs.description: The Elantra 1.6 SE manual (573 pages) has no text layer at all, and the Porter H-100 manual (272 pages, passed through the free online tool iLovePDF) is almost entirely page images. Ctrl+F finds nothing, text cannot be copied, and screen readers cannot read them.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Go to After Sales > Owner's Manual
Click Download under ELANTRA 1.6 SPECIAL EDITION
Open the downloaded PDF
Press Ctrl+F and search for a word visible on the page, such as "CAUTION"
bugs.expected: A text-based PDF, or one with OCR, so owners can search a 573-page manual for a topic.
bugs.actual: Search finds no results on any page; the file contains only page images.
bugs.oracle: WCAG 2.1 SC 1.1.1 (Non-text Content) and PDF accessibility practice (PDF/UA) require real text. A 573-page reference document that cannot be searched defeats its purpose.

bugs.title: Owner's manuals are generic, dated editions written for left-hand-drive cars (Elantra 2020, IONIQ 5 2022)
bugs.technique: Business Rule Testing, Data Integrity Testing, Static Testing (Reviews), Download Testing
bugs.description: The manual's cover does not name any model, its copyright is 2020, and the cover warns that "some models are equipped with Right-Hand Drive (RHD). The explanations and illustrations for some operations in RHD models are opposite of those written in this manual." Cars sold in Pakistan are right-hand drive. The IONIQ 5 manual (created 2022) and Tucson Hybrid manual (2024) carry the same left-hand-drive warning on their covers.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Go to After Sales > Owner's Manual
Click Download under ELANTRA 1.6 SPECIAL EDITION
Open the downloaded PDF
Read the cover page and the Foreword (page F4)
bugs.expected: A manual for the Elantra 1.6 Special Edition as sold in Pakistan: model named, current edition, written for right-hand drive.
bugs.actual: Generic Hyundai manual, "Copyright 2020", no model named, written for left-hand drive with a note that RHD operations are reversed.
bugs.oracle: Data integrity oracle: the link is labelled for a specific 2026 Pakistan model. Pakistan drives on the left with RHD cars, so the manual's instructions and illustrations are mirrored for every local owner.

bugs.title: Tucson Hybrid manual's text layer is corrupted: searching or copying gives gibberish
bugs.technique: Data Integrity Testing, Accessibility Testing, Static Testing (Reviews), Download Testing
bugs.description: The Tucson Hybrid manual (downloaded as NX4-Hybrid-G1.6T-GDi.pdf) shows normal text on screen, but its hidden text layer uses a broken font encoding. Copying "OWNER'S MANUAL" gives "2:1(5Ŕ60$18$/", so Ctrl+F cannot find ordinary words in its 754 pages and screen readers read nonsense.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Go to After Sales > Owner's Manual
Click Download under TUCSON HYBRID and open the PDF
Select and copy the text "OWNER'S MANUAL" on the cover page and paste it anywhere, or press Ctrl+F and search for "Maintenance"
bugs.expected: Copied text matches what is on the page; searching for "Maintenance" finds the word.
bugs.actual: Copied text is shifted characters ("Operation" becomes "2SHUDWLRQ"); searching for real words finds nothing.
bugs.oracle: PDF accessibility practice (PDF/UA) and WCAG 2.1 SC 1.1.1 require a text layer that matches the visible text. The other manuals on the same page (e.g. IONIQ 5) extract correctly, so this file is defective.

bugs.title: Content-Security-Policy allows 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval' scripts, weakening protection against XSS
bugs.technique: Security Headers Testing, Security Testing, Vulnerability Scanning, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Testing
bugs.description: The site sends a Content-Security-Policy, but its script-src includes 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval'. These two keywords let inline scripts and eval() run, which removes most of the protection CSP gives against cross-site scripting. securityheaders.com caps the grade because of it. (Found with a passive scan only; no attack was attempted.)
steps: Open https://securityheaders.com
Enter hyundai-nishat.com and click Scan
Read the Warnings section and the Content-Security-Policy raw header
bugs.test_data: Scan of https://hyundai-nishat.com/ on 8 Nov 2026, 13:31 UTC
bugs.expected: script-src limited to 'self' and named hosts, using nonces or hashes for inline scripts, with no 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval'.
bugs.actual: script-src 'self' https://www.googletagmanager.com 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; warning: "This policy contains 'unsafe-inline' which is dangerous… 'unsafe-eval' which is dangerous".
bugs.oracle: OWASP Content Security Policy Cheat Sheet and the scanner's own warning: unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval defeat CSP's main purpose. Combined with the weak name and comment validation found on the forms (BUG-013, BUG-026), input handling deserves review.

bugs.title: Server header reveals the exact web server version: "Apache/2.4.58 (Ubuntu)"
bugs.technique: Security Headers Testing, Sensitive Data Exposure Testing, Security Testing
bugs.description: Every response includes "Server: Apache/2.4.58 (Ubuntu)", telling anyone the web server software, its exact version and the operating system.
steps: Open https://securityheaders.com and scan hyundai-nishat.com
Read the Server row in Raw Headers (or check the Network tab in Chrome DevTools)
bugs.expected: A generic Server value (e.g. "Apache") or no Server header.
bugs.actual: Server: Apache/2.4.58 (Ubuntu)
bugs.oracle: OWASP guidance on information leakage (fingerprinting): exact version numbers let attackers look up known vulnerabilities for that version. securityheaders.com flags it under Additional Information.

bugs.title: Second SSL certificate (served to clients without SNI) does not match hyundai-nishat.com and is reported as not trusted
bugs.technique: HTTPS / SSL Testing, Security Testing, Compatibility Testing
bugs.description: The site scores A+ on SSL Labs and its main certificate is valid. However, the server also presents a second certificate, issued only for www.hyundai-nishat.com, to clients that do not send SNI. For the domain hyundai-nishat.com, SSL Labs marks it "Alternative names … MISMATCH" and "Trusted: No, NOT TRUSTED".
steps: Open https://www.ssllabs.com/ssltest/
Enter hyundai-nishat.com and wait for the report
Scroll to the second certificate and read Alternative names and Trusted
bugs.expected: Every certificate the server can present covers both hyundai-nishat.com and www.hyundai-nishat.com.
bugs.actual: Overall A+, but the second certificate lists only www.hyundai-nishat.com: "MISMATCH" and "NOT TRUSTED" for hyundai-nishat.com.
bugs.oracle: Certificate hostname matching (RFC 6125): a certificate must name the host being visited. Older clients that do not support SNI would see a certificate error instead of the site.

bugs.title: Home page is very slow on mobile: Lighthouse Performance 48, main content appears after 25.1 s
bugs.technique: Performance Testing, Page Load Speed Testing, Low Bandwidth / Network Throttling Testing
bugs.description: In a clean Incognito run (no extensions) on mobile, the home page scores 48/100 for Performance. Largest Contentful Paint (when the main content becomes visible) is 25.1 s and Speed Index 5.8 s; the filmstrip shows a blank white screen for the first several frames. Render-blocking requests add about 1.4 s. An earlier run with extensions scored 38 with LCP 19.3 s, so the problem is consistent.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com in Chrome
Press F12 and open the Lighthouse tab
Select Mobile and all four categories, then click Analyze page load
bugs.expected: Performance score of 90+ and Largest Contentful Paint under 2.5 s (Google's "good" threshold).
bugs.actual: Performance 48; LCP 25.1 s; Speed Index 5.8 s; First Contentful Paint 2.6 s; Total Blocking Time 100 ms.
bugs.oracle: Google Core Web Vitals thresholds: LCP ≤ 2.5 s is good, > 4.0 s is poor. At 25.1 s, ten times the target, mobile visitors wait a long time for the page and many will leave.

bugs.title: Page layout jumps while loading: Cumulative Layout Shift 0.367
bugs.technique: Performance Testing, Visual Regression Testing, Usability Testing
bugs.description: As the home page loads, content moves around: Lighthouse lists "layout shift culprits". Cumulative Layout Shift is 0.367 in both runs, including the clean Incognito run, almost four times the 0.1 limit for a good score.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com in Chrome
Press F12 and open the Lighthouse tab
Select Mobile and all four categories, then click Analyze page load
bugs.expected: CLS of 0.1 or less, with images and banners given fixed sizes so nothing moves.
bugs.actual: CLS 0.367; Lighthouse flags layout shift culprits.
bugs.oracle: Google Core Web Vitals: CLS ≤ 0.1 is good, > 0.25 is poor. Shifting content makes users tap the wrong element.

bugs.title: Home page downloads 6 MB, with unoptimised images and no long-term caching
bugs.technique: Performance Testing, Volume Testing, Low Bandwidth / Network Throttling Testing
bugs.description: Lighthouse reports a total network payload of 6,091 KiB. It estimates savings of 3,233 KiB from better image delivery, 3,858 KiB from proper cache lifetimes, 52 KiB of unused CSS, 29 KiB of unused JavaScript and 16 KiB of legacy JavaScript. JavaScript execution takes 2.2 s and main-thread work 5.7 s.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com in Chrome
Press F12 and open the Lighthouse tab
Select Mobile and all four categories, then click Analyze page load
Expand Insights and Diagnostics
bugs.expected: A home page well under 2 MB, images served in modern formats at the right size, and static files cached for a long time.
bugs.actual: 6,091 KiB payload; ~3.2 MB of image savings and ~3.9 MB of caching savings available.
bugs.oracle: Lighthouse "Avoid enormous network payloads" audit and web performance practice; a 6 MB page is costly and slow on Pakistani mobile data connections.

bugs.title: Accessibility audit failures: unnamed dialog, unnamed links, low contrast and skipped heading levels
bugs.technique: Accessibility Testing, Screen Reader Testing, Colour Contrast Testing
bugs.description: Lighthouse Accessibility scores 90 but lists four failed checks: elements with role="dialog" have no accessible name (the booking pop-up), links have no discernible name (icon-only links such as social media), text does not have enough contrast, and headings skip levels.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com in Chrome
Press F12 and open the Lighthouse tab
Select Mobile and all four categories, then click Analyze page load
Scroll to the Accessibility section
bugs.expected: All four checks pass: dialogs and links have names screen readers can announce, contrast meets 4.5:1, and headings go in order (h1, h2, h3).
bugs.actual: Four failed accessibility checks.
bugs.oracle: WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value), 1.4.3 (Contrast) and 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships). Screen-reader users hear "link" or "dialog" with no description.

bugs.title: Browser errors are logged to the console on the home page
bugs.technique: Error Handling Testing, Grey-Box Testing, Performance Testing
bugs.description: Lighthouse Best Practices (92) fails "Browser errors were logged to the console" and "Issues were logged in the Issues panel in Chrome DevTools".
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com in Chrome
Press F12 and open the Lighthouse tab
Select Mobile and all four categories, then click Analyze page load
Scroll to Best Practices
Open the Console tab in DevTools to see the errors
bugs.expected: No JavaScript errors or DevTools issues on page load.
bugs.actual: Console errors and DevTools issues are reported.
bugs.oracle: Lighthouse Best Practices audit: console errors point to broken scripts or failed requests that can break features silently.

bugs.title: "Booking your Hyundai?" pop-up covers the home page on every visit, even on mobile
bugs.technique: Usability Testing, Mobile Device Testing, Static Testing (Reviews), Session Management Testing, Cross-Browser Testing, Pop-up / Modal Testing
bugs.description: About one second after the home page loads, a large pop-up about booking documents covers the page. In phone view it hides the banner and most of the screen. The page source shows the pop-up (pum-3109) is set to auto-open after 1,000 ms with no cookie, so it returns on every visit even after being closed. Cross-browser check: the same pop-up opens on desktop in Microsoft Edge (ENV-3), covering the middle of the home page.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com in phone view (F12, Ctrl+Shift+M)
Wait one second
Close the pop-up, reload the page
bugs.expected: Booking information shown on the booking page, or a pop-up that appears once and is remembered after the user closes it.
bugs.actual: The pop-up appears on every load and covers most of the mobile screen.
bugs.oracle: Google's guidance on intrusive interstitials (pop-ups that cover the main content on mobile hurt usability and search ranking). Usability heuristic: user control and freedom — a dismissed message should stay dismissed.
bugs.reproducibility: Always (Chrome mobile view and Edge desktop)

bugs.title: SEO audit: links without descriptive text and links search engines cannot crawl
bugs.technique: SEO Testing, Static Testing (Reviews)
bugs.description: Lighthouse SEO scores 85 and fails "Links do not have descriptive text" (1 link found, e.g. generic text such as "Read more") and "Links are not crawlable" (links that use JavaScript or "#" instead of a real address).
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com in Chrome
Press F12 and open the Lighthouse tab
Select Mobile and all four categories, then click Analyze page load
Scroll to the SEO section
bugs.expected: Every link has descriptive text and a real href that search engines can follow.
bugs.actual: Two failed SEO checks.
bugs.oracle: Google Search Central link best practices: crawlable links need an href with a URL, and link text should describe the destination.

bugs.title: Booking Status terms end mid-sentence: "…Provisional Booking Order (PBO) form and"
bugs.technique: Static Testing (Reviews), Content and Spelling Testing, Business Rule Testing
bugs.description: Term 3, which users must accept before checking their booking, stops at "as per the terms and conditions outlined in your Provisional Booking Order (PBO) form and". The clause is unfinished. None of the four terms ends with a full stop.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Booking Status in the blue bar under the banner
Read Terms & Conditions item 3
bugs.expected: Complete, punctuated terms, e.g. "…in your Provisional Booking Order (PBO) form."
bugs.actual: Item 3 ends with "form and"; no item ends with a full stop.
bugs.oracle: Legal text users must agree to (the checkbox is required) has to be complete; an unfinished clause leaves its meaning unclear.

bugs.title: Field hints misuse "i.e": "Enter valid format i.e 1402406"
bugs.technique: Content and Spelling Testing, Usability Testing
bugs.description: The PBO No and CNIC/NTN placeholders read "Enter valid format i.e 1402406" and "Enter valid format i.e 12345-6789012-3". "i.e." means "that is", so the hint says the only valid value is the sample; "e.g." (for example) is meant, and the abbreviation is missing its final full stop.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Booking Status in the blue bar under the banner
Look at the empty PBO No and CNIC/NTN Number fields
bugs.oracle: English usage: "e.g." introduces an example, "i.e." restates the only meaning. The placeholder also disappears once typing starts, so users lose the format hint.

bugs.title: Run-on subtitle: "Your Journey, Our Priority Stay Updated on Your Car Booking!"
bugs.technique: Content and Spelling Testing, Static Testing (Reviews)
bugs.description: The Booking Status subtitle joins two sentences with no punctuation: "Your Journey, Our Priority Stay Updated on Your Car Booking!"
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Booking Status in the blue bar under the banner
Read the subtitle under the "Booking Status" heading
bugs.expected: "Your journey, our priority. Stay updated on your car booking!"
bugs.actual: "Your Journey, Our Priority Stay Updated on Your Car Booking!"
bugs.oracle: English punctuation: two independent sentences need a full stop or dash between them.

bugs.title: Booking Status accepts letters in both PBO No and CNIC/NTN ("abc", "hello") and submits without any format check
bugs.technique: Input Validation Testing, Negative Testing, Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis
bugs.description: Both field hints ask for a "valid format" (PBO No: digits such as 1402406; CNIC: 13 digits as 12345-6789012-3), but the form accepts letters in both fields and submits them to the server, which returns the results page instead of a format error.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Booking Status in the blue bar
Type abc in PBO No and hello in CNIC/NTN Number
Tick "Yes, I agree to terms" and click Submit
Repeat with PBO No 12345 and CNIC abcdef
bugs.test_data: Run 1: PBO No abc, CNIC hello. Run 2: PBO No 12345, CNIC abcdef.
bugs.expected: A message under the field such as "Enter a 13-digit CNIC (12345-6789012-3) or a valid NTN"; the form is not submitted.
bugs.actual: No format error in either run; the form submits and shows "No booking found with the provided PBO Number and CNIC Number."
bugs.oracle: Equivalence partitioning: a CNIC is 13 digits, so alphabetic input is an invalid class that should be rejected before submission. The field's own hint promises format checking. Server-side lookups with junk values also add needless load.

bugs.title: Booking Status result page highlights "Press Release" as the active menu item
bugs.technique: Navigation Testing, GUI Testing, State Transition Testing
bugs.description: After submitting the Booking Status form, the result page (breadcrumb "Home > Booking Status Details") shows "Press Release" in the main menu as the current section, with the blue underline. The page has nothing to do with press releases.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com and click Booking Status
Enter any PBO No and CNIC, tick the terms box and click Submit
Look at the main menu on the result page
bugs.expected: No main-menu item highlighted (Booking Status is not in the main menu), or the correct section highlighted.
bugs.actual: "Press Release" is highlighted with the active underline.
bugs.oracle: Navigation consistency: the active menu item tells users where they are. The form page itself highlights nothing, so the result page's state is wrong.

bugs.title: Dealer phone numbers use at least six different formats, including an invalid "92-021-…" international number
bugs.technique: Data Integrity Testing, Content and Spelling Testing, Checklist-Based Testing
bugs.description: Numbers in the Authorized Dealerships table are written in many styles: "042-32592245", "042 111 111 991", "+92 48-216-1515", "+92 304 111 4468", ranges such as "052-3575091-92" and "0812471823-25", and "92-021-35361464-6" for City Store Karachi. The last mixes the country code (92) with the trunk zero (021), so dialling it as written fails from abroad. The City Store Lahore card on the same page writes the table's "042-32592245" as "(+92 42) 3259 2245".
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Find a Dealer in the main menu
Scroll to Authorized Dealerships
Read the Contact No. column for all 27 dealers
bugs.expected: One consistent format, e.g. "+92 21 3536 1464" or "021-35361464", with ranges written as separate numbers.
bugs.actual: At least six formats; "92-021-35361464-6" is not a valid international number.
bugs.oracle: ITU-T E.123 notation: international format drops the trunk prefix 0 after the country code (+92 21 …). Consistency also helps users who tap numbers on mobile.

bugs.title: Map beside "City Store Lahore" points to the head office in Gulberg, not the store in Johar Town
bugs.technique: Integration Testing, Data Integrity Testing, Use Case Testing, Map Integration Testing
bugs.description: The card at the bottom of the page is titled "City Store Lahore" with the address Emporium Mall, Abdul Haque Road, Johar Town. The embedded map next to it shows a pin and place card for "Hyundai Nishat Motor (Private…), 1-B Aziz Avenue, Canal Rd, Gulberg V", a different part of Lahore.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Find a Dealer in the main menu
Scroll to the map at the bottom of the page
Compare the City Store Lahore card's address with the place shown in the map's top-left box
bugs.expected: The map shows the City Store Lahore location at Emporium Mall, Johar Town.
bugs.actual: The map pin and place card show 1-B Aziz Avenue, Canal Road, Gulberg V.
bugs.oracle: Data integrity oracle: the map and the card next to it must describe the same place. A customer reading the card and following the map goes to the wrong location.

bugs.title: Rawalpindi has a dealer but cannot be chosen on the Test Drive form
bugs.module: Request a Test Drive form – City list
bugs.technique: Integration Testing, Data Integrity Testing, Equivalence Partitioning, Use Case Testing
bugs.description: Find a Dealer lists Hyundai Metropolitan in Rawalpindi (Swan Camp, GT Road), and its City filter includes Rawalpindi. The Request a Test Drive City list (Chakwal to Sukkur, 17 cities) has no Rawalpindi, so customers there cannot request a test drive at their local dealer.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/find-a-dealer/ and open the City filter (Rawalpindi is listed; dealer 17 is in Rawalpindi)
Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/request-a-test-drive/
Open the City drop-down and look for Rawalpindi
bugs.expected: Every city with a dealer appears in the Test Drive City list.
bugs.actual: Rawalpindi is missing from the Test Drive City list.
bugs.oracle: Data integrity across pages: the dealer directory is the reference list of cities with dealers. Rawalpindi is one of Pakistan's largest cities.

bugs.title: Online Booking gives no confirmation after Submit: the form just reloads empty
bugs.technique: Functional Testing, End-to-End Testing, Workflow Testing, Use Case Testing
bugs.description: After a complete booking is submitted, the page returns to a blank Online Booking form: no success message, booking or reference number, next steps or error.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com and click Online Booking
Select ELANTRA 1.6 SPECIAL EDITION, its variant, city Karachi and dealer Hyundai-City-Store-Karachi
Fill Name, Email and Mobile with test values and click Submit
bugs.test_data: Model: Elantra 1.6 SE (ex-factory PKR 6,449,000); City: Karachi; Dealer: Hyundai-City-Store-Karachi; test name, email and mobile
bugs.expected: A confirmation screen with a booking or reference number, what happens next (payment, documents, dealer contact) and confirmation that an email has been sent.
bugs.actual: The form is cleared and shown again, exactly as on first load. The user cannot tell whether the booking was received.
bugs.oracle: Usability heuristic "visibility of system status": a PKR 6.4 million transaction must confirm success or failure. Without feedback users resubmit (duplicates) or give up, and the Booking Status page needs a PBO number this flow never gives.

bugs.title: Mobile field accepts a 12-digit number ("032020356578") on the booking form
bugs.technique: Boundary Value Analysis, Input Validation Testing, Field Length Testing
bugs.description: Pakistani mobile numbers are 11 digits (03XX-XXXXXXX), and the field's own placeholder shows 11 X's. The form accepted the 12-digit "032020356578" and submitted the booking without an error.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Online Booking in the blue bar
Fill the booking form
Type 032020356578 (12 digits) in Mobile
Click Submit
bugs.expected: "Enter an 11-digit mobile number (e.g. 03XXXXXXXXX)"; submission blocked.
bugs.actual: Accepted without error; the form submitted.
bugs.oracle: Boundary value analysis: 11 digits is the valid length, so 12 (upper boundary + 1) must be rejected. A wrong number on a car booking means the dealer cannot reach the customer.

bugs.title: Mobile number hint differs between forms: "XXXXXXXXXXX" here, "XXXX - XXXXXXX" elsewhere
bugs.technique: GUI Testing, Content and Spelling Testing, Checklist-Based Testing
bugs.description: The Online Booking Mobile field shows the hint "XXXXXXXXXXX" (no separator), while Book a Service and Request a Test Drive show "XXXX - XXXXXXX". Users cannot tell whether to type a dash.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Online Booking in the blue bar
Look at the empty Mobile field
Compare it with the Mobile field on Book a Service or Request a Test Drive
bugs.expected: One mobile format and hint used on every form, e.g. "03XX-XXXXXXX".
bugs.actual: "XXXXXXXXXXX" here; "XXXX - XXXXXXX" on the other forms.
bugs.oracle: Consistency across the site's forms (same field, same format), and a hint showing the leading "03" helps users enter a valid number.

bugs.title: No visible keyboard focus: pressing Tab gives no outline or highlight on the selected menu item
bugs.technique: Keyboard Navigation Testing, Accessibility Testing, Usability Testing
bugs.description: When the home page is used with the keyboard, Tab moves focus to the menu (Find a Car is reached after two presses), but the focused item shows no outline, underline or colour change. The user cannot see where focus is until Enter is pressed and the menu opens.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com in Chrome
Click an empty area of the page
Press Tab twice (focus moves to Find a Car)
Look for a focus outline on the selected item
Press Enter
bugs.expected: The focused link has a clearly visible focus indicator (outline or highlight) at every Tab press.
bugs.actual: No focus indicator is shown on any item. Only after Enter does Find a Car turn blue and the Find a Car panel open, which confirms focus was on it.
bugs.oracle: WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 2.4.7 Focus Visible (Level AA): any keyboard-operable interface must have a visible focus indicator. Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot navigate a page whose focus is invisible.

bugs.title: Footer "Sitemap" link opens the home page instead of a sitemap
bugs.technique: Broken Link Testing, Navigation Testing, XML Sitemap and robots.txt Testing
bugs.description: The Sitemap link in the footer of every page points to /sitemap/, which redirects to the home page. No sitemap page exists.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Scroll to the footer
Click Sitemap
bugs.expected: A page listing all sections of the site (or the link removed).
bugs.actual: The browser lands on the home page (https://hyundai-nishat.com/), scrolled to the top.
bugs.oracle: A link's label is a promise of its destination. A link that silently redirects to the home page is a broken link in effect and misleads users looking for an overview of the site.

bugs.title: Site search shows only the first 10 results with no way to see more (9 pages exist)
bugs.technique: Search Functionality Testing, Boundary Value Analysis
bugs.description: Searching "Hyundai" shows 10 results and ends with no page numbers or Next link. The site itself has 9 pages of results (/page/2/?s=Hyundai returns "Page 2 of 9"), so about 80 matching pages cannot be reached from the search page. Ranking is also weak: for "Tucson" the main Tucson Hybrid page is 9th, after a used-car listing and sub-pages.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Type Hyundai in the Search box at top right and press Enter
Scroll to the end of the results
Repeat with Tucson
bugs.expected: Pagination (page numbers or Next) under the results; the main model page ranked first for a model name.
bugs.actual: Only 10 results, no pagination. "Tucson" lists Tucson 2.0 AWD (a used car) first and the Tucson Hybrid page 9th.
bugs.oracle: Search results must give access to every match. WordPress already generates /page/2/ to /page/9/, so the missing links are a template defect, and hidden results are effectively lost.

bugs.title: Empty search returns a random list of pages titled "Search Results For:"
bugs.technique: Search Functionality Testing, Null / Empty Input Testing
bugs.description: Pressing Enter with an empty search box (URL ?s=) shows "Search Results For:" with nothing after it, followed by 10 unrelated pages (Tucson 2.0 AWD, Palisade Hybrid sub-pages, Sell Your Car, Submit Listing…).
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click the Search box, leave it empty and press Enter
bugs.expected: Empty search is ignored or a message asks the user to type a search term.
bugs.actual: Heading "Search Results For:" (blank) and 10 unrelated results.
bugs.oracle: Null input should be handled gracefully; showing arbitrary content as "results" for nothing is confusing.

bugs.title: Search with no matches shows a generic "Not Found" page with no search box or suggestions
bugs.technique: Search Functionality Testing, Error Message Testing, Negative Testing, 404 Error Page Testing
bugs.description: Searching for a term with no matches ("xyz123") shows the same page as a missing URL: "Not Found – Sorry, but you are looking for something that isn't here." The term searched is not repeated, and there is no search box to try again or links to popular pages.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Search for xyz123
bugs.expected: "No results for 'xyz123'" with a search box to try again and links to models or Contact Us.
bugs.actual: Generic "Not Found" message; breadcrumb "Home > Not Found".
bugs.oracle: Usability heuristic "help users recognise and recover from errors": a no-results page should tell users what was searched and how to continue.

bugs.title: Search box looks like plain text: no border, icon or button
bugs.technique: Usability Testing, GUI Testing
bugs.description: The word "Search" in the top bar is actually an input field, but it has no border, magnifier icon or button and looks like one more text link next to Contact Us. Clicking it seems to do nothing until you start typing.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Look at the top bar
Click Search
bugs.expected: A recognisable search field (border or magnifier icon) and a search button.
bugs.actual: "Search" appears as a plain label; nothing visible happens on click.
bugs.oracle: Users recognise search by its standard look (box plus magnifier). A hidden search box is rarely used, so the feature is effectively undiscoverable.

bugs.title: Online Booking: choosing a city with no dealer lists all 27 dealers nationwide without a message
bugs.technique: Pairwise (All-Pairs) Testing, Business Rule Testing, Decision Table Testing
bugs.description: The City list has 236 cities, but dealers exist in about 16. For cities with a dealer the Dealer list is filtered (Lahore: 5, Islamabad: 2, Rawalpindi: 1). For a city without one, such as Awaran, the Dealer list shows every dealer in Pakistan (Chakwal, Karachi, Peshawar, Sukkur…) with no note that there is no local dealer. Tested with model/city pairs including Tucson Hybrid + Awaran, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Multan, Peshawar and Quetta. (The Dealer list was expanded for the screenshot.)
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Online Booking
Choose TUCSON HYBRID
Choose City: Awaran
Open Dealer Name
bugs.test_data: Model: Tucson Hybrid; City: Awaran (and 6 other cities)
bugs.expected: "No dealer in Awaran – nearest dealers:" with the closest ones, or only cities that have dealers in the list.
bugs.actual: All 27 dealers in alphabetical order by dealer name; Karachi and Peshawar dealers offered to a customer in Awaran.
bugs.oracle: Business rule shown by the form itself: the Dealer list depends on City. The rule breaks for the 220 cities without a dealer, so customers may book with a dealer hundreds of km away.

bugs.title: Mobile field accepts the letter "e" ("0300e1234567") and then treats the number as empty
bugs.technique: Special Character Testing, Input Validation Testing
bugs.description: The Mobile field is an HTML number field, so the browser allows the letter "e" (scientific notation). "0300e1234567" is shown in the field, but the field's value becomes empty, so the user sees a number while the form receives nothing.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/request-a-test-drive/
Click Mobile
bugs.expected: Only digits can be typed (a text field with a digits pattern, e.g. inputmode="numeric").
bugs.actual: "0300e1234567" is displayed; the field's value is "" (invalid).
bugs.oracle: A phone number is not a quantity; number fields allow e, +, - and decimals. What the user sees must match what is submitted.

bugs.title: Partly filled Test Drive form is cleared when the page is refreshed
bugs.technique: Interrupt Testing, Usability Testing
bugs.description: After typing a name and email, pressing F5 (or an accidental refresh or Back/Forward) clears every field; nothing is restored.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/request-a-test-drive/
Type a name and an email
Press F5
bugs.expected: Typed values are kept after a refresh (browser form restore or a saved draft).
bugs.actual: All fields are empty after the reload.
bugs.oracle: Interruption (refresh, call, network drop) is common on phones; losing input forces users to retype everything and increases form abandonment.

bugs.title: Site is declared as US English (lang="en-US") and has no Urdu option
bugs.technique: Localization Testing, Internationalization Testing
bugs.description: Every page declares lang="en-US" although the site serves Pakistan, and there is no Urdu version or language switch. Price formats also differ: "PKR 6,449,000 /-", "PKR 7,300,000" and "PKR 5,772,500".
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Look for a language option
Check the page language declared by the site (DevTools > Elements > <html lang>)
bugs.expected: lang="en-PK" (or "ur" for an Urdu version) and one price format across the site.
bugs.actual: lang="en-US"; no Urdu; mixed price formats.
bugs.oracle: Localization: content, language tags and formats should match the target market. Screen readers and search engines use the lang attribute.

bugs.title: Cookies set without Secure or SameSite flags, and tracking cookies set with no consent prompt
bugs.technique: Cookie Security Testing, Security Testing
bugs.description: The site sets four cookies on the first visit: the first-party visitor ID vx_user and three Google Analytics cookies (_ga, _ga_135281560, _ga_GT0TD9QRX9). None has the Secure or SameSite attribute, vx_user is not HttpOnly, and all last about a year. They are set straight away, although the footer links to a Cookie Policy and no consent banner is shown.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/find-a-dealer/
Press F12 and open Application > Storage > Cookies > https://hyundai-nishat.com
Read the HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite columns
bugs.expected: Cookies marked Secure and SameSite=Lax (or Strict), the site's own vx_user cookie marked HttpOnly, and non-essential tracking cookies set only after the visitor agrees.
bugs.actual: HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite are empty for all four cookies; the tracking cookies are set before any consent is asked for.
bugs.oracle: OWASP Session Management and Cookie guidance: cookies on an HTTPS site should carry Secure and SameSite, and identifiers not needed by scripts should be HttpOnly. The site's own Cookie Policy link implies visitors are told about and can control tracking cookies.

bugs.title: Resume upload gives no confirmation after a file is chosen, and does not accept Word files or state the allowed types
bugs.technique: File Upload Testing, Usability Testing, Error Message Testing
bugs.description: On the Career page, choosing a file for Resume gives no feedback: after a PDF was selected and Open clicked, the box still read "Attach your resume" with no file name, tick or error. The field only accepts .pdf, .png, .jpg and .jpeg (the file dialog opens filtered to "Custom Files"), so Word CVs (.doc/.docx), the most common CV format, are excluded, and the page never states the allowed types or a size limit.
bugs.preconditions: None (form not submitted; it goes to the company's HR team)
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/career/
Click Attach your resume
Note the file-type filter in the dialog (Custom Files)
Choose a PDF file and click Open
Look at the Resume box
bugs.test_data: A PDF report file from the tester's computer
bugs.expected: The chosen file name appears in the box (with a way to remove it); allowed types (including .doc/.docx) and the size limit are shown next to the field.
bugs.actual: The box still says "Attach your resume" after a file is chosen. Allowed types are PDF/PNG/JPG only and are not stated on the page.
bugs.oracle: Usability heuristic "visibility of system status": the user must see that the upload worked before submitting a job application. File-upload good practice is to state allowed formats and size, and to accept the formats applicants normally use.

bugs.title: "Trending around you" tiles cut off their captions mid-sentence ("Choose the ELANTRA Hybrid and")
bugs.technique: Layout and Alignment Testing, Content and Spelling Testing, Configuration Testing
bugs.description: The home page shows six Instagram posts as square tiles. The tiles crop the post images, so the text printed on them is cut at the bottom edge: "Choose the ELANTRA Hybrid and…", "Bring home the SANTA FE Hybrid and…" and the small "Easy installment plans" line. The same cut appears at 100% and 125% Windows scaling and in the phone view.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Scroll to Trending around you
Read the bottom line of the first, fourth and sixth tiles
bugs.test_data: Windows display scale 100% and 125%; Chrome phone view
bugs.expected: Each tile shows the whole post, or its caption is complete.
bugs.actual: Captions end mid-sentence at the tile's bottom edge.
bugs.oracle: Content must be readable as published; a sentence cut at "and" looks broken and loses the offer details the post is advertising.

bugs.title: Home page has 27 main headings (<h1>), two of them empty, and 15 empty id attributes
bugs.technique: Heading Structure Testing, HTML Validation Testing, Static Testing (Reviews)
bugs.description: Each banner slide uses an <h1>, and the slider repeats the slides, so the home page has 27 <h1> elements (13 different headings, two of them empty). The page also has 15 elements with an empty id attribute (id="").
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Open DevTools > Console
Run document.querySelectorAll('h1').length and list their text
Run document.querySelectorAll('[id=""]').length
bugs.expected:
One

describing the page; banner titles as

/

; no empty headings or empty id attributes.
bugs.actual: 27 <h1> (2 empty); 15 empty id attributes.
bugs.oracle: HTML and WCAG good practice (1.3.1 Info and Relationships): headings describe page structure; screen-reader users navigate by headings, and search engines use the <h1> as the page topic. Empty id attributes are invalid HTML.

bugs.title: 40 car images share the same alt text "Vehicle" instead of the model name
bugs.module: Home page / Find a Car panel
bugs.technique: Image Alt Text Testing, Accessibility Testing
bugs.description: All model images in the Vehicles section and the Find a Car panel have alt="Vehicle". A screen reader announces "Vehicle, Vehicle, Vehicle…", and the image cannot tell users which car it shows if the name label is missed.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Open DevTools > Console
Run [...document.images].filter(i => i.alt === 'Vehicle').length
bugs.expected: Each image's alt text names the model, e.g. alt="Hyundai Tucson Hybrid".
bugs.actual: 40 images with alt="Vehicle".
bugs.oracle: WCAG 2.1 SC 1.1.1 Non-text Content: alternative text must serve the same purpose as the image. Identical generic alt text on different images fails that purpose.

bugs.title: Dealer phone numbers in the table are plain text and cannot be tapped to call
bugs.technique: Click-to-Call and Email Link Testing, Mobile Device Testing, Usability Testing
bugs.description: The Authorized Dealerships table lists 27 dealers with phone numbers, but none is a tel: link, so phone users must copy or retype the number. The two links that do exist (City Store Lahore card) put spaces and brackets inside the link: tel:(+92 42) 3259 2245.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/find-a-dealer/ on a phone (or DevTools phone view)
Tap a number in the Contact No. column
Inspect the number in the City Store Lahore card
bugs.expected: Every number is a tappable link in international format, e.g. tel:+924232592245.
bugs.actual: Table numbers are plain text (0 of 27 rows have a link); the card links contain spaces and brackets.
bugs.oracle: On a dealer-finder page the main task is contacting the dealer. Mobile usability guidelines expect phone numbers to be click-to-call; RFC 3966 defines tel: links as digits with an optional leading +.

bugs.title: Form fields have no autocomplete attributes, so browsers cannot reliably fill name, email and phone
bugs.module: Book a Service, Request a Test Drive, Online Booking forms
bugs.technique: Form Autocomplete Attribute Testing, Accessibility Testing
bugs.description: The name, email and mobile fields on the three main forms have no autocomplete attribute (e.g. autocomplete="name", "email", "tel").
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/book-a-service/
Open DevTools > Console
List each field's autocomplete attribute
Repeat on Request a Test Drive and Online Booking
bugs.expected: autocomplete="name", "email" and "tel" on the matching fields.
bugs.actual: No autocomplete attribute on any of these fields.
bugs.oracle: WCAG 2.1 SC 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose (Level AA): fields collecting the user's own information must declare their purpose so browsers and assistive tools can fill them.

bugs.title: Easy Own: SONATA 2.5 instalment figures are wrong: admin charges added twice
bugs.technique: Data Integrity Testing, Business Rule Testing, Static Testing (Reviews)
bugs.description: For SONATA 2.5 (PKR 11,545,000, 50% down payment = 5,772,500) the "Balance Payable of Price" column shows 5,972,500 and 6,072,500 instead of 5,772,500, i.e. the admin charges are already included. The next column adds the admin charges again (6,172,500 and 6,372,500). The monthly instalments (331,806 × 18 = 5,972,500; 253,021 × 24 = 6,072,500) match neither total column. Every other model in the table calculates correctly.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com
Click Hyundai Easy Own
Find the SONATA 2.5 row
Check: price − down payment = balance; balance + admin = total; total ÷ tenure = monthly
bugs.expected: Balance 5,772,500 for both tenures; totals 5,972,500 and 6,072,500, matching 331,806 × 18 and 253,021 × 24.
bugs.actual: Balance 5,972,500 / 6,072,500; totals 6,172,500 / 6,372,500, which do not match the monthly instalments.
bugs.oracle: Arithmetic oracle and consistency with the other rows of the same table. Wrong financing figures on a PKR 11.5 million purchase mislead customers about what they will pay.

bugs.title: WordPress default "Sample Page" (bike messenger, piña coladas) is live and listed in the sitemap
bugs.technique: Static Testing (Reviews), Content and Spelling Testing, XML Sitemap and robots.txt Testing
bugs.description: https://hyundai-nishat.com/sample-page/ shows WordPress's default demo text under the Hyundai header: "Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night… I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas." The page is listed in page-sitemap.xml, so search engines are invited to index it.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/sample-page/
Read the page
Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/page-sitemap.xml and search for sample-page
bugs.expected: Default CMS pages deleted before go-live; only real content published and listed in the sitemap.
bugs.actual: WordPress demo text published under the Hyundai brand and listed in the sitemap.
bugs.oracle: Release checklist and brand-consistency oracle: placeholder content on a corporate site looks unprofessional and appears in search results.

bugs.title: A public "Test" page with a test contact form is live and listed in the sitemap
bugs.technique: Static Testing (Reviews), Security Testing, Error Guessing
bugs.description: https://hyundai-nishat.com/test/ (breadcrumb "Home > Test") shows an unstyled default contact form (Your name, Your email, Subject, Your message). It is listed in page-sitemap.xml. A leftover test form may still deliver messages to an unmonitored inbox and is an easy spam target.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/test/
bugs.expected: Test pages removed or blocked before release.
bugs.actual: A test page with a working-looking form is public.
bugs.oracle: Release checklist: test artefacts must not ship to production. Unmonitored forms are a spam and data-handling risk.

bugs.title: Blank developer page "No Header Footer" is live and listed in the sitemap
bugs.technique: Static Testing (Reviews), Broken Link Testing
bugs.description: https://hyundai-nishat.com/no-header-footer/ shows only the words "No Header Footer" in default black serif text on a white page, with no site header, footer or navigation. It is listed in page-sitemap.xml.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/no-header-footer/
bugs.expected: Template or test pages are not published.
bugs.actual: An empty developer template page is public and indexed.
bugs.oracle: Release checklist: unused templates should be removed; users or search engines landing here see a broken-looking page with no way back.

bugs.title: Same press release published twice ("…financing facilities to customers" and "…-2")
bugs.technique: Data Integrity Testing, Static Testing (Reviews)
bugs.description: The December 2019 press release about bank financing partnerships exists at two URLs, the second ending in "-2". Both have the same headline and the same date (Dec 02, 2019) and both are in press-sitemap.xml.
steps: Open /press/collaboration-between-hyundai-nishat-motor-private-limited-and-leading-banks-to-provide-special-car-financing-facilities-to-customers/
Open the same URL ending in -2/
Compare headline and date
bugs.expected: One page per press release.
bugs.actual: Two near-identical pages with the same headline and date.
bugs.oracle: Duplicate content confuses readers and search engines (duplicate titles split ranking).

bugs.title: 126 pages have no meta description; Press Release and Culture pages have no main heading
bugs.technique: SEO Testing, Page Title and Meta Description Testing, Heading Structure Testing
bugs.description: A read-only crawl of the 211 pages in the site's own sitemap found 126 pages with no meta description (including the genuine-parts pages and /feedback/). /press/ and /our-culture/ have no <h1>. Two different pages share the title "Pre Booking Open Now - Hyundai Nishat".
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/sitemap_index.xml
Open each listed page and check <meta name="description">, <h1> and <title>
bugs.expected: Every public page has a unique title, a meta description and one <h1>.
bugs.actual: 126 pages without a description; 2 without an <h1>; a duplicate title.
bugs.oracle: SEO good practice (Google Search Central): titles and descriptions should be unique and present on each page; they form the search-result snippet.

bugs.title: "New vehicle coming soon" page sends visitors to the developer's staging server, which fails
bugs.technique: Navigation Testing, Broken Link Testing, Security Testing
bugs.description: https://hyundai-nishat.com/new-vehicle-coming-soon/ is listed in page-sitemap.xml. Opening it redirects the browser to hyundai-nishat.dev.crewlogix.com, the web developer's staging server, which does not load (Chrome error page). This exposes the development environment's address and leaves the page broken.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/new-vehicle-coming-soon/
Look at the address and page title Chrome shows
bugs.expected: The page loads on hyundai-nishat.com, or is removed from the sitemap.
bugs.actual: Redirect to hyundai-nishat.dev.crewlogix.com and a Chrome error page.
bugs.oracle: Production pages must not point to staging hosts (OWASP: information exposure; release checklist). Related to BUG-003, which exposes the same developer's email.

bugs.title: "Pre Booking Open Now" page for the TUCSON Hybrid is still live 18 months after launch
bugs.technique: Data Integrity Testing, Content and Spelling Testing
bugs.description: /pre-booking/ still invites customers to pre-book "The All New Hyundai TUCSON Hybrid 2025" with a booking form, but the site's own press release dated May 7, 2025 announces that the TUCSON Hybrid has launched across Pakistan.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/pre-booking/
Open Press Release and find the TUCSON Hybrid launch (May 7, 2025)
bugs.expected: Expired campaign pages removed or redirected to the current model page / Online Booking.
bugs.actual: "Pre Booking Open Now" with a live form for a car launched in May 2025.
bugs.oracle: Consistency oracle: two pages of the same site contradict each other; outdated offers mislead customers.

bugs.title: Feedback form requires a registration or PBO number (and a home address) before anyone can send feedback
bugs.technique: Required Field Testing, Usability Testing, Business Rule Testing
bugs.description: On Contact Us > Feedback, "Reg No / PBO #" and "Address" are both mandatory. A person who has not bought a car (for example after a bad test drive or showroom visit) has no registration or PBO number and cannot submit a complaint, suggestion or query.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/feedback/
Look at the required (*) fields
bugs.expected: Only name, a contact method and the message required; Reg No / PBO optional.
bugs.actual: Reg No / PBO # * and Address * are required.
bugs.oracle: Feedback channels should be open to all customers; unnecessary required fields block the task and collect more personal data than needed.

bugs.title: Feedback form lists old models (Staria, "Elantra", "Tucson") and misses current ones (Palisade, IONIQ 5/6, hybrids)
bugs.technique: Data Integrity Testing, Equivalence Partitioning
bugs.description: The Model list on the Feedback form offers Elantra, Sonata, Tucson, Santa Fe, Staria, Porter H100 and Other. Current models such as Palisade Hybrid, IONIQ 5, IONIQ 6, Elantra Hybrid and Sonata N Line are missing, while Staria is not in the current line-up.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/feedback/
Open the Model list
Compare with Find a Car
bugs.expected: The same model list as Find a Car.
bugs.actual: An outdated list of 6 models plus Other.
bugs.oracle: Consistency oracle with the site's own Find a Car menu (same problem as BUG-022 on Book a Service).

bugs.title: Feedback form City list has 13 cities and Dealership list 23 dealers, although the site lists 27 dealers
bugs.technique: Data Integrity Testing, Equivalence Partitioning
bugs.description: The City list omits cities that have dealers (Rawalpindi, Gujrat, Mardan, Hyderabad, Sukkur), and the Dealership list omits Hyundai Blue, Mardan, Hyderabad and Sukkur that appear on Find a Dealer. The dealer list is also not filtered by the chosen city.
steps: Open https://hyundai-nishat.com/feedback/
Open City and Dealership name
Compare with Find a Dealer (27 dealers)
bugs.expected: Every city and dealer from Find a Dealer available, with dealers filtered by city.
bugs.actual: 13 cities, 23 dealers, no filtering.
bugs.oracle: Consistency with Find a Dealer; customers of the missing dealers cannot direct feedback correctly.

bugs.title: Used-car listing gives two different phone numbers: buttons call 0325-5557080, text says 0325-5556046
bugs.technique: Data Integrity Testing, Click-to-Call and Email Link Testing
bugs.description: On the Hyundai Promise listing for the Tucson 2.0 AWD, the Call and WhatsApp buttons use +92 325 5557080, but the description says "Contact # 0325-5556046". A buyer cannot tell which number is correct.
steps: Open Hyundai Promise > Browse Vehicles > Tucson 2.0 AWD
Inspect the Call and WhatsApp buttons
Read the Contact # line in Description
bugs.expected: One contact number used everywhere on the listing.
bugs.oracle: Consistency oracle: the same listing must not contradict itself; a wrong number loses the sale.

bugs.title: Used-car listing description labels the model as "Make" and the year as "Model"
bugs.technique: Content and Spelling Testing, Data Integrity Testing
bugs.description: The description reads "Make: Tucson 2.0 AWD" and "Model: 2022". The make is Hyundai, the model is Tucson 2.0 AWD and 2022 is the year; the Specifications box on the same page labels them correctly (Model: Tucson 2.0, Year: 2022).
steps: Open the Tucson 2.0 AWD listing
Compare the Description with the Specifications box
bugs.expected: Make: Hyundai; Model: Tucson 2.0 AWD; Year: 2022.
bugs.actual: Make: Tucson 2.0 AWD; Model: 2022.
bugs.oracle: Consistency with the Specifications box on the same page and with standard vehicle-listing terms.

bugs.title: Used-car "Download Brochure" button goes through a third-party link shortener (2ly.link)
bugs.technique: Security Testing, Download Testing
bugs.description: The Download Brochure button on the listing links to https://2ly.link/1tUwd instead of a file on hyundai-nishat.com. Users cannot see where the link leads before clicking, and the brochure depends on a third-party service.
steps: Open the Tucson 2.0 AWD listing
Hover over or inspect Download Brochure
bugs.expected: A direct link to a brochure hosted on hyundai-nishat.com.
bugs.actual: Link to the shortener 2ly.link.
bugs.oracle: Security awareness guidance: shortened links hide their destination and are a common phishing pattern; official downloads should come from the official domain.

bugs.title: Price-list PDFs have no date or validity period
bugs.technique: Download Testing, Data Integrity Testing
bugs.description: The price lists linked from the model pages (e.g. Sonata, uploaded July 2025; Palisade Hybrid "Launch", September 2026) are headed only "Hyundai - HNMPL Price List(s)" with no issue date or "valid from" date. The terms say prices are "subject to change without prior notice".

Look for an issue or validity date
bugs.expected: Each price list shows its issue date or the date from which prices apply.

bugs.title: Legal Disclaimer claims to govern Hyundai's global site www.hyundai.com
